Select target_chembl_id, target_name, target_type, protein_accession, protein_sequence. Source: target_dictionary, target_components, component_sequences. Join: target_dictionary.tid = target_components.tid AND target_components.component_id = component_sequences.component_id. Filter: target_dictionary.target_type = 'SINGLE PROTEIN'. Sort: target_chembl_id ASC, target_name ASC, target_type ASC, protein_accession ASC, protein_sequence ASC.
